text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Ow, ouch...! That hurts way more than I expected!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"No, but I see... The pain from this injury
is sending a constant stimulus deep into my body."
choice_data_list: I hope you get better soon
I hope you get better soon!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Given the severity of the injury, though...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: "I'd like to thoroughly look into whatever I can investigate while having this opportunity."
choice_data_list: Let's just stay quiet and rest.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"I'm fine. A little scratch like this will heal right up.
And as for treatment, I should observe it a bit more first—"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
...Fine, I get it.
What's with the scary look on your face?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Alright, alright.
For now, I'll leave the management of this injury to you.
I took good care of Agnes Tachyon, who seemed to have resigned herself.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Aren't you supposed to be
worried and trying to stop me here?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: What will you do if the injury gets worse?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Haaah... To begin with, with pain this severe,
my brain doesn't seem capable of proper thought."

I carefully tended to Agnes Tachyon
as she let out a painful, heavy sigh...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh,
I knew you would say that!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
For starters, you'll be carrying bags, driving me around, giving me shoulder rubs...
Yep, I've got plenty of other favors to ask too!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: In the meantime, I shall thoroughly investigate this injury!
It seemed she treated even her own injury as part of the research. Despite enduring the pain, Agnes Tachyon appeared to be in high spirits.
